summary: Final readout for Avernelwick Pharmaceuticals Ltd, 26 Aug 2024. Low recovery confounded the first RED PPB run; revised labware provided an interpretable free-fraction ranking. HLM/RLM stability and the repeat binding results support the next screening gate.

slides.title: Acceptance before interpretation
slides.footer: Brindlewythe Biosciences Ltd, a Tarnovell company | Confidential
bullets: The first RED PPB run was confounded by low dialysis recovery; do not use that run to rank binding.
The repeat with revised labware gave an interpretable free-fraction ranking.
Read recovery alongside unbound fraction before drawing a screening conclusion.
HLM/RLM stability and RED PPB answer different questions; neither substitutes for exposure testing.
slides.notes: Keep the original and repeat run sheets distinct. Recovery is an interpretation constraint, not a measure of binding strength.

slides.title: HLM/RLM stability: screening set
slides.footer: Brindlewythe Biosciences Ltd, a Tarnovell company | Confidential
slides.notes: 0.5 mg/mL microsomal protein; compound at 1 µM. Compare human and rat clearance within each compound.

slides.title: Human microsomal clearance
slides.footer: Brindlewythe Biosciences Ltd, a Tarnovell company | Confidential
bullets: Lower intrinsic clearance is the favourable direction for this screen gate.
Use the paired rat values to assess species-dependent turnover.
slides.notes: The plot follows the recorded screening-set order; it does not assign a mechanism.

slides.title: RED PPB: interpretable repeat
slides.footer: Brindlewythe Biosciences Ltd, a Tarnovell company | Confidential
slides.notes: Human plasma; equilibrium dialysis for 4 h at 37 °C. Revised labware was used after the first binding run was confounded. Read bound fraction, unbound fraction and recovery together.

slides.title: Free-fraction comparison after the repeat
slides.footer: Brindlewythe Biosciences Ltd, a Tarnovell company | Confidential
bullets: The repeat permits relative free-fraction ranking within the AP02 screening set.
Higher unbound fraction alone does not establish a better exposure profile.
slides.notes: No correction has been inferred for the uninterpretable first run.

slides.title: AP02: representative chemistry
slides.footer: Brindlewythe Biosciences Ltd, a Tarnovell company | Confidential
slides.notes: Aminopyrimidine regioisomer screening set. These assays do not establish the cause of a clearance or binding difference.

slides.title: Progression decision
slides.footer: Brindlewythe Biosciences Ltd, a Tarnovell company | Confidential
bullets: Use the repeat RED PPB ranking for progression; set aside the first-run binding ranking.
Prioritise compounds combining lower human clearance with an interpretable free-fraction result.
Retain the human/rat comparison for exposure-testing selection.
bullets_right: AP02-01400 remains traceable in both assay tables.
Do not nominate a compound from binding alone.
Agree the exposure-testing selection with Avernelwick Pharmaceuticals Ltd using the paired results.
slides.notes: A named exposure lead is not assigned by this readout.
